journeys.name: Apartment funding selection to pending and return
observations: Selected $100 and Household checking; review preserved both and scoped one-time consent. Confirmation reached Pending, explicitly unavailable to spend, and Back to card returned Apartment.
On this browser viewport, review and pending inherited prior scroll position, initially hiding heading and amount. Verify reset-scroll behavior.

journeys.name: Taylor limit change, return, pause and restore
observations: Selected $150, review and success preserved it; returned through people list and reopened Taylor at $150. Pause and restore confirmation also retained $150 and Utilities; final permission screen was Active at $150.
Static default $200 screenshots were not evidence of a reset bug: live variables preserved the chosen amount.
Multiple transitions retained scroll position, hiding headings until scrolling up. Prototype behavior only; no real permissions changed.

journeys.name: Introduction consent, sending, pending and withdrawal
observations: Consent enabled sending. Sending transitioned to pending confirmation; View request opened pending details; withdrawal opened confirmation and withdrawn outcome. No Circle membership or financial consent was represented.
Figma Fit width and height resolved earlier viewer clipping. This did not establish unreachable product controls.

journeys.name: Host accepts Alex and opens conversation
observations: Accept & open conversation led to accepted outcome, then Message Alex opened Alex Rivera conversation. Listing stayed open; no Circle membership was created. Stale node names mention Joseph but rendered actor was Alex.

journeys.name: Blocked Inbox to housing conversation
observations: Directly opened blocked Inbox fixture: Maya subscription marked Blocked / Read-only. Maple Street inquiry opened Maya Chen housing conversation with visible Write a message composer and no blocked label.
This is inconsistent visual blocking across fixtures. No message send or backend bypass is claimed; person-wide block behavior needs reconciliation.
